Sherkhi

[unclear]

Sherkhi village, 10 km from Vadodara, is the karmabhoomi (place of spiritual work) of Ravidas, disciple of both [Sant Shashtaprajnadasji and Bhan Saheb]. Bhan Saheb was himself the disciple of Sant Shashtaprajnadasji, the fourth-generation saint in the lineage of Nilkanthdas.
